title: Pip the knight: rig, six animations and a 190-frame sprite sheet, all generated as code by an AI model
author: Effective_Form_2396
selftext:
Pip runs on a small rig: a hip root, spine and head, two bones per arm and leg solved with 2-bone IK, a sword and shield locked to the hands, and damped spring chains on the cape and plume so they trail the motion.

It was made in two stages by SenseNova 6.8 Code2Video. First the model computed every pose into one file, then a separate pass drew only those poses in flat cel style with 3 px outlines. The six clips (idle, run, jump, a 3-hit combo, hit and victory) come to 190 frames, and the sprite sheet at the end is drawn from the same pose data. It also checked that bone lengths never change, feet stay planted within 0.25 px outside the knock-back, and loops wrap cleanly. Footsteps, whooshes and hits are timed from the pose events.

[https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-6.8-Code2Video](https://github.com/OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-6.8-Code2Video)
